claims.evidence: All 20 workbook acquisition names exactly match the .d directories containing analysis.tdf in the ZIP index and the 20 --f paths in the DIA-NN log.

claims.value: SHR or WKY at 30 or 40 weeks
claims.evidence: Workbook groups are SHR 30w (5), SHR 40w (7), WKY 30w (4), WKY 40w (4); paper reports the same four groups and sample counts.
Each filename has a unique SHR or WKY individual identifier; 20 unique identifiers match the paper's 20 rats.

claims.value: male Rattus norvegicus cerebral artery tissue
claims.evidence: The paper specifies male rats and cerebral arteries; PRIDE organism and organism-part fields agree.

claims.value: hypertension in SHR; normal in WKY
claims.evidence: PRIDE description calls SHR spontaneously hypertensive and WKY normotensive controls; the disease value varies by row.
PRIDE data protocol explicitly says DIA PASEF on a Bruker timsTOF Pro.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], reduction and alkylation
claims.value: Trypsin plus Lys-C; TCEP and chloroacetamide
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol explicitly names overnight Trypsin/LysC mix and TCEP plus 2-chloroacetamide.

claims.value: fixed C carbamidomethyl; variable M oxidation
claims.evidence: DIA-NN command line has --unimod4 and --var-mod UniMod:35,15.994915,M.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Log reports DIA-NN automatic mass-accuracy optimization; no fixed search tolerance is deposited.

limitations: The ZIP central directory was read by HTTP range, not the 25 GB raw payload; analysis.tdf presence was verified for every acquisition directory but individual Bruker headers were not inspected.
DIA-NN --min-pr-mz/--max-pr-mz and --min-fr-mz/--max-fr-mz are search filters, not confirmed instrument acquisition ranges, so no SDRF scan-range columns were set.
The offline parser warns that the two strain names are absent from its ncbitaxon ontology list; both are the paper's explicit strain names.

The reconciliation helper flags a control-arm disease conflict and a missing Lys-C term. These are false positives for this file: disease is row-specific, and two repeated cleavage-agent columns hold Trypsin and Lys-C respectively.
